note: Hiring & Onboarding → Background Verification. Structured BGV per employee: the checks, each check's outcome, the overall status, and the re-verification schedule. SmartPRS 2 has these as a hard-coded field list; here a tenant adds a check (e.g. 'Drug test') by editing this file, and Compliance Alerts read `next_due` from the same rows.
documents_note: Owner, 21 Oct 2026 flow: the employee document fields (Organization Setup → Employee fields → Documents) shown beside each check on the BGV desk.
agency_mail_note: Owner, 21 Oct 2026: Background Verification → Send to agency. The employee details (these Employee field codes, in this order) go in the email body and an attached CSV; documents on file are attached up to attach_limit_mb in total.
due_soon_note: Re-verifications due within this many days are highlighted amber on the BGV desk; past due is red.
